name: notesqr
description: Anonymous WebRTC P2P file and folder sharing — no signup, any size, cross-device including mobile browsers.

interface.shortDescription: Anonymous P2P file sharing — no signup, any size
interface.longDescription: Share files and folders peer-to-peer via WebRTC. Host a room with notesqr_p2p_send, share the notesqr.com URL (works on mobile browsers), download with notesqr_p2p_recv. Both peers must stay online; bytes are not stored on NotesQR servers.
defaultPrompt: Send this build APK to my phone with NotesQR
Host these QA logs in a P2P room and give me the URL
Download files from this NotesQR room URL
